text:
hana-rt: rolled hybrid-slab + async-prefetch into helix-canary this morning. putting numbers here for visibility.
omar-bench: nice. high level numbers? p50/p95/p99 + cost?
hana-rt: p50 ~ -3% overall; p95 -9%; p99 -20% for short-prefixed convs. per-token cost down ~11% in the canary cohort. throughput improved ~5% under steady load.
lucy-sre: any 5xx or OOM signals?
hana-rt: no new 5xx. one transient spike in scheduler queue length at T+7m that auto-resolved after the allocator warmed. no OOMs.
mike-pm: what's different from previous async-slab runs?
hana-rt: hybrid-slab separates hot vs pooled allocations and pairs it with async-prefetch that pre-warms recent KV entries without blocking packers. also added a microburst smoothing window to the coalescer to avoid packer thrash.
omar-bench: bench command to reproduce:```bash
./bench --model helix-conv --qps 500 --seq-dist short:80,med:15,long:5 --dur 30m --alloc hybrid-slab --kv-prefetch async --coalescer microburst-window
```
hana-rt: baseline vs canary: baseline p99 210ms -> canary 168ms; p95 92ms -> 84ms; p50 28ms -> 27ms; cost/token $0.00038 -> $0.00034; kv-hit +24%.
lucy-sre: rollout plan? health checks?
hana-rt: staged by capacity groups: canary -> 20% for 45m -> 50% for 2h -> full. health checks: p99, 5xx rate, scheduler-queue-len, kv-hit-rate. auto-rollback if p99 regresses >6% sustained for 10m or 5xx rate jumps >0.2% absolute.
mike-pm: add an alert for packer-thrash: coalescer.retries > baseline+5% (5m).
lucy-sre: will add that and gpu_mem.used > baseline+180MB (10m). also adding a dashboard tile for microburst-window occupancy.
omar-bench: validated on fp16 and int8; int4 paths tested with a smaller sample and look consistent.
hana-rt: small note: the microburst smoothing introduces a tiny p50 penalty for very tiny sequences but reduces p95/p99 more than enough to justify. documented in PR #4551.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for group: helix-hybrid-canary. 20% -> checks running.
lucy-sre: graphs look stable at T+15m. kv-hit stable, queue-len returned to baseline.
mike-pm: can we get a 1-line for the product update and an ops blurb for the all-hands?
hana-rt: prod blurb: "Hybrid-slab allocator with async prefetch reduces p99 latency by up to 20% and lowers token costs for prefix-heavy workloads; rolling now." ops blurb: "Staged rollout; alerts in place for p99, 5xx, and packer thrash; auto-rollback thresholds set."
lucy-sre: please post bench graphs and the PR link after full rollout.
hana-rt: will post graphs and config knobs in #eng-runtime and link PR #4551 once full is done.
omar-bench: great work team :tada:
mike-pm: :thumbsup:
